headline: Review of SEL Curriculum Policy, E-Bike and Micromobility Safety Policy, AI and Emerging Technologies Policy, and Section J recommendations.
summary: The subcommittee will consider the SEL Curriculum Policy, review new proposed policies on e-bike safety and artificial intelligence, discuss PROTECT Act policy and procedures, and review and approve recommendations for Section J.
items: Initial Review of Proposed E-Bike and Micromobility Safety Policy
Initial Review of Proposed Artificial Intelligence and Emerging Technologies Policy
Review and Approval of Recommendations for Section J, including Section J with changes
